page.title: AI Conformance
page.purpose: Let operators run or inspect AI inference conformance scans, understand maturity level results, and identify which scenarios need migration or investigation.

priorities.statement: Show findings by scenario, maturity level, severity, and fix path.
Distinguish advisory lower-maturity findings from failing higher-maturity requirements.
Make approved exceptions visible with owner, reason, expiry, and replacement plan.

states.description: Scan controls are available before a scan result exists.
Maturity level, findings, and recommendations are visible.
The scan failed and the error is visible.

claims.statement: AI conformance scan controls are visible before findings are shown.
Scan controls precede the result region in reading order.
